data.subtitle: Chef‑crafted, nutritionally balanced dishes delivered to your door, so you can save time, stay healthy, and focus on what matters.

data.title: Why Busy Professionals Choose BiteBox
paragraphs: Between meetings, deadlines, and life outside the office, cooking can feel like another task on your to‑do list. BiteBox removes that friction by handling meal planning, shopping, and prep for you.
Each meal is designed by nutritionists and chefs to give you the right mix of protein, carbs, and veggies, delivering steady energy without the guesswork.
